question: Can independent published same-isolate routine-AST versus reference-method measurements reproduce reference-sensitive comparative genomic evaluation?
primary_gates: Published isolate-level table with identifiable two measurements or two explicit categories on the same biological isolate; publication aggregate counts alone are insufficient for a per-genome replay.
Primary-source genome/run/BioSample identities, antibiotic, units, method, standard and edition; missing details stay missing.
Only naturally collected clinical isolates; experimental resistance-selection derivatives are excluded.
K.pneumoniae matching the frozen classifier; other taxa can inform source-feasibility but are not scored by this species model.
Exclude PRJNA1322038 from independent reference-effect claims; report same-study publication reuse.
Exact overlap screen against fitting, E2 and CCRE with known limitations; unknown identities do not establish independence.
Preserve raw MIC inequalities and I/ND. Primary paired binary comparisons require explicit S/R under both references; do not force I to S/R.
No model score or method-discordance used to choose isolates. Preserve all eligible results, including agreement and null effects.
analysis_if_gates_pass: Fixed predictions assessed under both legitimate assay references; paired error counts, BA/MCC/AUROC only when defined; FN/FP tradeoffs retained.
Separate temporal record changes from independent AST-method differences; neither discrepancy alone proves an error.
Reference-method status follows documented methods, not genotype agreement.
Publish source-selection flow, all exclusions and source-level sensitivity; no invented clinical outcomes or acceptance probability.
stop_rules: No author contact to obtain nonpublic data.
If primary matched two-reference/genome table unavailable, report blocked/ineligible and stop that branch.
A new single-reference MIC validation cohort alone does not resolve independent-reference-effect bottleneck.
No claim bottleneck resolved until new reference-sensitive result and its independent evidence are actually verified.
